$schema.description: URI of the JSON schema used to validate this file.

language.description: Language the project is written in. Defaults to "typescript".

app.description: Command that runs the app and synthesizes its stacks, e.g. "npx tsx main.ts".

output.description: Directory synthesized stacks are written to.

codeMakerOutput.description: Directory generated provider and module bindings are written to.

projectId.description: Anonymous project identifier attached to telemetry and crash reports.

sendCrashReports.description: Whether the CLI sends crash reports.

sendUsageTelemetry.description: Whether the CLI sends anonymous usage telemetry.

terraformProviders.description: Providers to generate bindings for with `cdktn get`.

terraformModules.description: Modules to generate bindings for with `cdktn get`.

context.description: Context values passed to the app, including feature flags.

targetVersions.description: npm semver ranges of the Terraform-compatible CLIs the project supports, written to required_version.

watchPattern.description: Glob patterns `cdktn watch` watches. Written with the language's default on the first run if unset.

validateInstalledBinary.description: When true, diff, deploy and destroy check the installed binary satisfies targetVersions before running it.

importExtension.description: TypeScript only. Suffix appended to relative imports in generated code; use ".js" or ".ts" for ESM.

oneOf.description: Source with an optional version constraint, e.g. "<source>@<version>".
